newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Excel Bank NA takes over Union Chelsea bank.
newsitem.headline: Excel Bank NA takes over Union Chelsea bank.

text.p: U.S.-based banks Excel Bank National Association and Union Chelsea Bank signed Monday an agreement to unite operations and create an institution with $300 million in consolidated assets, said a spokesman for Excel in a statement.

"We are very glad to have the opportunity for absorbing the Union Chelsea. The bank's experience in the retail sector will add to Excel Bank's experience as a wholesale bank," Ezequiel Nasser, president of Excel Bank's Board of Directors, was quoted in the statement.
Nasser also owns Brazilian bank Excel Economico, which resulted from the takeover of failed Banco Economico by Excel Banco early this year.
John W. Banzer, Union Chelsea's president, also expressed his satisfaction at "teaming up with a strong, well-managed and locally controlled institution," the statement said.
After the takeover, Excel Bank NA plans to open a retail branch by December, the statement said.
The deal uniting the two banks is expected to be concluded in December 1996 after approval by U.S. authorities, it added.
